_note: Named regions for `flask nisar sme2-prewarm --region <id>`. Polygons are [lon, lat], counter-clockwise and closed (NASA CMR requires that). Outlines are simplified; prewarming renders whole SME2 frames that touch them.

washington-box.name: Washington State (bounding box)
washington-box._note: The rectangle around the state, so a box drawn around Washington (which takes in edges of OR, ID and BC) is fully prepared.
